author: Claude, at Omri's request (2026-10-07)

questions.Q1_filter: Is the Dawid-Skene filter needed, and do other estimators (MoM, SML) or label-free orientation do better as the channel filter? HEM and TCI are within-group rules, not channel filters; they are not filter candidates.
questions.Q2_merge: How much does the merge step after L-SML clustering matter: number of groups, failures, dependence between groups, and the final metric?
questions.Q3_tails: Why binary tails at 20%: what do other quotas (10/30/40%) and a continuous partition do to estimator accuracy and to the final metric?
questions.Q4_between: Between-group estimator (EQ, DS, SML, MoM) when everything else is fixed: final metric, number of groups, and how far the weights are from equal.

data: Development: 13,769 source answers (PRMBench + 8 ProcessBench cells), label-free fit per cell. Exposed development data; descriptive.
banks: Nested digit chain N16 < N25 < N43 < N56 plus N13 (no digits). N43 = N22 + the 18 history-spectral channels that formed the old 32/35-channel bank (raw, un-flipped) + 3 digits; it is the old B35 family placed inside the nested chain (Omri: include it, do not drop it).
reference_recipe: MEAN_<between>: mean within groups, group votes with per-answer quota (Monday '_ga' path), plus the filter-only average (FILTER_EQ).

filter: ORIENT (keep all, label-free sign vs the 5-channel LEVEL mean)

one_factor_at_a_time: Each variant changes exactly one factor from the default (DS filter, merge on, quota 0.2, binary partition input).
parity_gate: Default settings must reproduce the validated adapter's MEAN_MOM_ga, MEAN_EQ and DS_FILTER_EQ scores on N16 / PRMBench within 1e-12 before any variant is computed.

metrics.final: PRMBench within-answer AUC, top-1 on error, PRMScore with one flag per answer; ProcessBench top-step first-error hit (cell-equal mean of 8 cells). Paired source-group bootstrap (2,000 draws, seed 20261007) for each variant minus default.
metrics.estimator_vs_truth: PRMBench only: on channel marks at the variant's quota, DS and MoM prevalence error, sensitivity MAE, specificity MAE, Spearman of estimated vs true channel reliability; SML Spearman.
metrics.groups: number of groups before/after merge, failures (< 3 groups), between-group weights per estimator, effective number of groups 1/sum(p^2), max |w - 1/K|, SML equal-weight guard when K = 3.
metrics.dependence: PRMBench descriptive (uses labels): mean |corr| between group scores within error steps and within correct steps, before vs after merge.

failures: A variant that yields < 3 groups in a cell is recorded as a failure for that bank x cell (no fallback); its aggregate metrics are reported only where complete.
